tweets.text:
Perplexity keeps saying they are attempting to replicate Bloomberg Terminal at 1% of the cost, so I decided to pay for the pro version and give it a try

Its probably better than using Yahoo Finance, but anyone with real investing experience will quickly recognize that it lacks the most basic functionality vs Bloomberg

Here a few that caught my eye
> No capital structure breakdown
> Trading levels for bonds or loans not available
> Analyst estimates and research reports not available
> Credit rating and profile inaccurate
> Cannot find any information on CDS spreads
> Short interest and holder information inaccurate
> You cannot upload entire portfolios and run regressions or factor analysis
> IPO calendar by region or sector not available
> Recent M&A transactions and advisor data is incorrect
> Most importantly, no IB chat for networking

Still a long way to go
https://t.co/yMAJoXFwxD
